description: Website technology detection API (BuiltWith/Wappalyzer alternative): given a URL, identify the CMS, frameworks, CDN and hosting, analytics, tag managers, payments and server software from headers, meta generator and script signatures, with evidence for each. Use for competitor analysis, lead qualification and sales prospecting: what is this site built with? Pay-per-call via x402 (USDC, Base).

_payment.description: Optional base64 x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE payload. Omit to receive payment requirements.

url.description: Website URL or domain to analyze (required), e.g. "https://example.com".

name: agentbit.tech_stack
title: Tech Stack Detection
